messages:
Sam: Kicking off canary for feature flag 'rank_v2' — starting at 5% for global canary cohort. Notifying oncall and ops. deploy-bot should post progress.

deploy-bot: rollout started feature=rank_v2 cohort=canary percent=5 status=started ts=2003004567

Maya: Watching dashboards :eyes: check p95 latency and 500s on /generate (EU-WEST).

Jordan: Copy. If error rate > 1% I'll pin traffic back to stable and trigger rollback plan. Current canary image: inference/serve:2026.03.20-rc3.

deploy-bot: canary progress: feature=rank_v2 cohort=canary percent=5 -> 25 after 3m, status=healthy-checks-pending

Emily: Seeing a small uptick in 500s in eu-west: baseline 0.4% -> 1.8% over last 2m on /generate. Latency p95 also +120ms. Putting monitors in alert mode.

Maya: Hmm. Any error logs? sample trace?

Emily: quick snippet from cloudlogs: 
```
ERROR inference: scorer failed to decode logits: ValueError('invalid shape')
at model_runner.py:423
```

Sam: @Emily good catch. Pause the ramp. deploy-bot — hold at 25% and mark canary paused.

deploy-bot: action: hold rollout feature=rank_v2 cohort=canary percent=25 status=paused ts=2003004680

Jordan: I recommend rollback for eu-west cohort only, and pin routing to stable for eu region. Plan: 1) set flag eu-west -> 0%, 2) promote fallback scorer v1 for eu, 3) open bug with model team.

Sam: Agreed. Initiating targeted rollback for EU. Not doing global rollback yet. Oncall Emily, please collect traces and heatmaps.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated feature=rank_v2 cohort=eu-west from=25 -> 0 status=rolling-back ts=2003004722

Emily: Rollback in progress. Confirmed traffic shift for eu-west back to baseline within 30s. Continuing to collect traces, will post details in ~15m.

Maya: Updating release notes: "Canary for rank_v2 paused and eu-west cohort rolled back due to increased 500s; diagnostic traces collected; investigating model scoring/shape mismatch."

Jordan: After rollback completes, I'll pin routing config to inference/serve:2026.03.19-stable for eu until fix is deployed. Also add a transient throttling rule to avoid rapid re-ramp.

Sam: Thanks all. Postmortem ticket with links to traces and logs please. We'll re-run canary once model team confirms fix. :thumbsup:

Emily: Will add logs and initial triage in the ticket.

deploy-bot: rollout status summary feature=rank_v2 cohorts={global_canary:25 (paused), eu-west:0 (rolled-back)} actions_taken={hold, targeted_rollback} ts=2003004867
